_meta.facet: Once Human weapon mods and armor mods (incl. substat/suffix/levelling system)
_meta.gameVersion: Mod effects: OnceHumanDB scrape current as of mid-2026 (post Version 2.3.1 mod revamp, 2026-01-21); version markers up to Patch 3.0.7 (smus dataset 2026-09-30). Legacy tier values labelled as pre-2.3.1.
_meta.notes: Network policy in this session blocked direct fetches of every game wiki/news/community site (403 from egress proxy) and the WebSearch budget was exhausted after 11 queries. Mod data therefore comes from (a) 11 WebSearch result snippets, (b) community datasets cached in the shared scratchpad by the orchestrator (OHDB scrape via saitoh183, 0x91cea55 OCR database + in-game screenshot bible, Game8 list via bramsey, lredragol example builds, joseph meta-builds optimizer, smus guide data) and (c) raw.githubusercontent.com files of those repos. Percentages are plain numbers (12 = +12%). Null means not found; nothing is invented. Values marked 'estimate' come from a community optimizer's own guesses and must not be treated as game data.
accessLimitations: once-human.fandom.com, oncehuman.wiki.gg, game8.co, oncehumandb.com, wikily.gg, ohdex.gg, oncehuman.game, steamcommunity.com, reddit.com, primagames.com, metaforge.app, meta-builds.net, mmorpg.com - all 403 via egress proxy

weaponModSlots.classRestriction: No weapon-class restriction found for ranged weapon mods: a weapon mod fits any ranged weapon, but keyword mods (Burn, Frost Vortex, Shrapnel, ...) only function on weapons that carry that keyword. Melee weapons take melee-placement mods (OhDex filters: Ranged Weapon / Melee Weapon).
weaponModSlots.attachmentsAreSeparate: Attachments (Muzzle, Optic, Tactics, Magazine, Ammo - 5 categories) are a different system from the single mod slot and affect handling stats (stability, accuracy, range, reload, mag, velocity).

farmingLocations.Weapon: Monoliths / Prime War bosses (e.g. Vulnerability Amplifier from Arachsiam or Forsaken Giant; Shrapnel Smash from Monolith of Thirst)

currentSystem.effectiveFrom: Version 2.3.1 (2026-01-21), announced in the 2025-12-12 developer blog
currentSystem.rule: The four sub-attributes are no longer randomly generated but fixed to match the mod's core traits (e.g. a Frost Vortex weapon mod carries Frost Vortex DMG / Trigger Chance / Duration / Frost Elemental DMG).
currentSystem.modLevel: Mod level = sum of the four sub-attribute levels, maximum Level 17.
currentSystem.shinyMods: Level-17 'Shiny' versions exist with slightly higher main stats (0x91); smus data (patch 3.0.7): 'Shiny Mod (Lv17+) obtained via collection progress and Lv17 transforms (3.0.x system)'.
currentSystem.legacyMods: Mods obtained before 2.3.1 keep their randomly rolled sub-attributes (0x91).

legacySystem.conversionRules: Mod Conversion: 4 Common = 1 Rare, 3 Rare = 1 Epic (Steam Mod Conversion Guide, 2025).
legacySystem.enhancement: Enhancing a mod increases the value of one random existing substat; its rarity does not change. A mod can be enhanced 5 times to reach Level 10 ('intermediate quality'). Vortex Multiplier page: 'can be enhanced up to five times'.
legacySystem.substatPool: Weapon/Status DMG, DMG vs Normal/Elite/Great Ones, Weapon/Status/Weakspot DMG reduction, Reload Speed, Mag size, HP bonus; magnitude depends on the substat's rarity; harder content drops higher-rarity substats.
legacySystem.modTiers: Game8-era listings show mod tiers I-V with scaling main effects (e.g. Crit Boost I/II/III = 3/6/9% Crit Rate; Blaze Amplifier IV 2.5% vs V 3%).

suffixes.note: 0x91 calls this 'Talents' (Elemental DMG). Appears alone and combined with scenario suffixes (e.g. 'Lunar Deviant Energy', 'Resonance Deviant Energy').

suffixes.suffix: Keyword suffixes: Burn, Fast Gunner, Bounce, Unstable Bomber, Frost Vortex, Fortress Warfare, Shrapnel, Power Surge, The Bull's Eye
suffixes.note: Only on Weapon mods and Mask mods of the matching keyword. 0x91: 'Burn: Burn Trigger Chance +6% legendary; two pieces = +12%'.

suffixes.guaranteedSubAttribute: Crit DMG / Elemental DMG / Weapon-Status DMG scaling inversely with HP
base bonus + extra bonus when Shield >= 40%
sustained-damage bonus when dealing Weakspot, Crit and Elemental DMG
suffixes.note: Steam thread: 'Resonance suffix increases sustained damage output when dealing Weakspot, Crit, and Elemental DMG, available on pants and gloves in the Prime War.' Not a set bonus.

suffixes.guaranteedSubAttribute: Aberrant Progeny (Visional Wheel S3 / 3.0.x) exclusive suffixes

suffixes.note: Seen on OHDB 'Elemental Resonance (Aero Deviant Energy)' page; not in current scrape variant list.

modSetMechanics.note: No 'mod set' or 'mod resonance' set-bonus mechanic was found. 'Resonance' is (a) a mod SUFFIX on gloves/pants from Prime War and (b) part of mod names (Flame Resonance, Elemental Resonance) and an armor set name (Dark Resonance Set, v2.3.1). The 0x91 screenshot of United We Stand shows 'Same Legendary Mods required: 0/3', hinting at a per-mod same-mod-count condition rather than a set system.

damageBuckets.model: Keyword damage = Base x (1 + sum Factor bonuses) x (1 + sum Final bonuses). Factor and Final are each additive within the bucket and multiplicative with each other (0x91, 'UNCERTAIN - validate').
confirmedFinalBucketMods: Break Bounce (+25% Bounce Final, target >50% HP)
Frostwave Wither (+30% Frost Vortex Final, decaying 8%/s)
Pinpoint Strike (+35% Unstable Bomber Final, single target)
damageBuckets.translationNote: 'Ultimate DMG' (First Electrocution, Delayed Blast tooltips) is a translation of Final DMG Bonus per 0x91 ADR-002/014; 'DMG Coefficient' = Factor pool.
